DataSource.query:
select 

'IBM_PA_Cognos_Report_Designer' as AD_GRUPPE,
'S210200' as S_KENNUNG,
'Ralf Schulze' as NAME,
'ralf.schulze@ikb.de' as E_MAIL_ADRESSE,
'F4' as TEAM,
'CAMID("Azure:u:ralf.schulze@ikb.de")' as CAMID
from dual

union all

select
'IBM_PA_Cognos_Report_Designer',
'S211444',
'Martin Hermes',
'martin.hermes@ikb.de',
'F4',
'CAMID("Azure:u:martin.hermes@ikb.de")'
from dual

union all

select
p.ad_gruppe,
p.s_kennung,
p.name,
lower(k.email_adresse),
k.team,
'CAMID("Azure:u:'||lower(k.email_adresse)||'")' as CAMID

from vw_benutzerprofil_daten p,
vw_brs_kenn_daten k

where  p.vt_dat=to_date('31.12.4000','DD.MM.YYYY')
and k.vt_dat=to_date('31.12.4000','DD.MM.YYYY')
and p.s_kennung=upper(k.kennung)
and instr(p.ad_gruppe,'IBM_PA')<>0
and ad_gruppe<>'IBM_PA_Kosten'


order by 1,4
